android.desc:
120+ puzzles. Each puzzle with its own design and logic. 
All you have to do is use your brain and make/find the word here in more than 120 minimal challenging puzzles.
Simple.

Here is a clean-looking minimal puzzle game that requires your brain to think something different and outside the box every time. 

Each level looks simple and clean with one motive: to find the word here; but the puzzles in them are unique and have a set of varying difficulties. The puzzles involve different challenges like logic, memory, physics, word plays, brainy, reflexes, speed, and much more. The difficulty increases with the level number and each level come with 3 hints. Got stuck? Take a hint, find your way out, and make here. 

The game is packed with smooth animations and 100+ unique puzzles. It's easy to understand and simple to play, but not so easy to solve. Your puzzle-solving skills will be tested and we'll even set a mood by playing eerie and puzzling music for you.

For all kinds of age groups who love to connect the dots and solve puzzles!

It's here, but can you find it?

Music by N a t o o s h 

https://soundcloud.com/natooshvpw 
https://sleeplessvpw.bandcamp.com

Privacy Policy: https://www.techyonicgames.com/here-privacy-policy
